text:
ellie: Boreas wants a short perf POC before final purchase. Scope: chat completions (1k context) + realtime embeddings pipeline. They care about tail latency and predictable burst behavior. can eng/ops propose a compact runbook + a cost sketch for committed + burst?
tom: quick Qs: which model fidelity? 13B quantized preferred by many, but do they want an FP16 baseline too? target p95 for streaming tokens? sustained and peak qps?
ellie: they prefer quantized 13B if it meets p95 <= 300ms streaming. sustained 75 qps, occasional 3-minute spikes to 250 qps. embeddings: 800 reqs/min, 768-d vectors.
priya: propose 4-step runbook (quick smoke, warmup + sustained, burst cycle, cold-start verification). use synthetic traces derived from their sample corpus (avg prompt 150 tokens, gen 240 tokens). include KV cache warmup and cache-miss scenario.
tom: runbook draft:
```
step 0: sanity smoke 3m @ 1-2 qps (validate tokenization + auth)
step 1: warmup 15m steady @ 40 qps (populate prefix cache)
step 2: sustained ramp -> hold 75 qps for 25m (collect p50/p95/p99, token-cost)
step 3: bursts: 4 cycles 3m @ 250 qps with 4m cool-downs (observe queuing + error surface)
step 4: cold-start test: destroy node & hit 10 concurrent requests to measure tail
metrics: latency percentiles (token & request), tokens/sec, GPU mem/compute%, queue length, 5xx rate
```
priya: loadgen: use vegeta + a tiny SSE client for streaming. sample payload snippet: `{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<sample>"}],"max_tokens":240}` and `curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream`
liam: infra sketch: sustained 75 qps on 13B-quant -> ~2.5 A100-eq GPUs (we round up to 3 committed units for headroom). bursts to 250 qps via pre-warmed on-demand nodes: +3 GPUs. recommmend commit 3 units, burst pool 3x on-demand.
ellie: rough pricing please, high level for procurement.
tom: back-of-envelope: committed monthly (3 units) => ~$67k/month. burst usage burn rate: $140/hr per GPU * 3 => $420/hr during spikes. note: dedicated license + longer-term discount available. will refine after profiling.
priya: security checklist note: Boreas requires customer-managed KMS, VPC peering, audit events for each request, and an asset-scanned container image. we can run POC in dedicated preview with temporary keypair and capture logs. need their security contact and a signed DPA for logs transfer.
ellie: boreas contact? adding customer-sean (on thread) to confirm SSO/KMS/security owner.
customer-sean: thanks all. security lead will share questionnaire by EOD. we prefer HSM-backed keys. also please include a short doc listing failure modes and automatic mitigations so our infra team can accept the SRE playbook.
liam: quick failure-mode notes to include in the playbook: cold-start tail spikes, KV-cache eviction storms, ephemeral network glitches causing upstream retries, and sudden qps fan-in. mitigations: ramped pre-warm, prefix caching, short circuit to 7B variant under pressure, request-rate shaping + queue thresholds.
deploy-bot: deploy-preview: dedicated/poc-boreas-01 -> provisioning started at 2024-08-02T08:16:40Z :gear: 
ellie: timeline ask: can we run warmup + sustain tomorrow morning? deliver results + CSV summary in 36h?
priya: yes. I'll own payload corpus + loadgen. tom will run infra ops and provide refined cost after a quick profiling run. liam will handle the pre-warm choreography.
tom: deliverable format: small CSV with columns: phase,qps,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,tokens_per_s,gpu_util_pct,errors_pct and a 3-paragraph executive summary.
ellie: action items: priya (loadgen + corpora), tom (infra & cost refinement), liam (pre-warm ops), customer-sean (security questionnaire + SSO/KMS contact). I'll collate and send to Boreas legal. :thumbsup:
customer-sean: I'll ping security now, questionnaire to you in ~90 minutes. thanks team.
ellie: great. keep everything in this thread, we'll upload the CSV to the deal record. :rocket:
